newsitem.title: USA: U.S to sell $15 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills May 27.
newsitem.headline: U.S to sell $15 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills May 27.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $15 billion of three- and six-month bills on May 27 to pay down $5.5 billion as a total of $20.502 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued on May 29. The three-month bills mature on August 28 and the six-month bills mature on November 28.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127945K6 and for the six-month bills is 9127945V2.
